entities.title: Cannon/Home Village
entities.summary: Single-target ground turret (9 tiles, 0.8 s); optional geared-up burst mode (4 shots, 7 tiles); merges into Ricochet Cannon / Multi-Gear Tower.

entities.title: Archer Tower/Home Village
entities.summary: Single-target ground+air tower (10 tiles, 0.5 s); geared-up Fast Attack mode doubles fire rate at 8 tiles; merges into Multi-Archer Tower / Multi-Gear Tower.

entities.title: Mortar
entities.summary: Long-range ground splash artillery (4-11 tiles, 5 s, 1.5-tile splash, knockback); geared-up burst of 3 shells.

entities.title: Air Defense/Home Village
entities.summary: Air-only single-target rocket defense (10 tiles, 1 s, very high damage per hit).

entities.title: Wizard Tower
entities.summary: Short-range splash tower hitting ground or air (7 tiles, 1.3 s, 1-tile splash); two level 17 towers merge into a Super Wizard Tower.

entities.title: Air Sweeper
entities.summary: Damage-less air pushback defense (1-15 tiles, 5 s, faces one of 8 directions, can swivel 45 degrees each way).

entities.title: Hidden Tesla/Home Village
entities.summary: Hidden single-target zapper (ground+air, 7 tiles, 0.6 s) that stays invisible until a unit enters 6 tiles or 51% destruction.

entities.title: Bomb Tower/Home Village
entities.summary: Ground-only splash tower (6 tiles, 1.1 s, 1.5-tile splash) that explodes 1 s after destruction for level-scaled death damage in 2.75 tiles.

entities.title: X-Bow/Home Village
entities.summary: Rapid single-target crossbow (0.128 s): Ground mode 14 tiles or Air & Ground mode 11.5 tiles; 1,500-bolt ammo box.

entities.title: Inferno Tower/Home Village
entities.summary: Flame-beam tower (0.128 s ticks, ground+air): Single-Target mode ramps damage in 3 stages (0/1.5/5.25 s, 9 tiles); Multi-Target mode hits 5-6 units at flat DPS (10 tiles); 1,000-round ammo.

entities.title: Eagle Artillery
entities.summary: Map-wide artillery (7-50 tiles, ground+air) that stays dormant until 200 housing space is deployed, then fires 3-shell volleys at the densest hitpoint cluster; merged into the TH17 Town Hall.

entities.title: Scattershot
entities.summary: Heavy lobbed boulder (3-10 tiles, 3.2 s, ground or air per shot) whose fragments splash in a 90-degree cone up to 5 tiles behind the target with distance falloff; 90-shot ammo.

entities.title: Builder's Hut
entities.summary: Builder housing that, from TH14, becomes a 7-tile ground+air turret (0.4 s) whose Builder repairs nearby buildings during defense.

entities.title: Spell Tower
entities.summary: Spell-casting defense (TH15): one loadable spell per level - Rage (self, +60%), Poison (target, 60 DPS), Invisibility (self, 4.5 s), Earthquake (target, 30% max HP); casts again after a 50-70 s recharge and on destruction.

entities.title: Monolith
entities.summary: Dark Elixir single-target tower (11 tiles, 1.5 s, ground+air) whose shots add 11-15% of the target's maximum HP on top of base damage.

entities.title: Multi-Archer Tower
entities.summary: Merged from two level 21 Archer Towers (TH16): 3 archers each hit a different target (or focus fire when fewer are in range), 10 tiles, 0.6 s, ground+air.

entities.title: Ricochet Cannon
entities.summary: Merged from two level 21 Cannons (TH16): ground-only 9-tile cannon (0.8 s) whose ball ricochets once to a second unit within 3.5 tiles for 70% damage.

entities.title: Multi-Gear Tower
entities.summary: Merged from a geared-up level 21 Cannon + geared-up level 21 Archer Tower (TH17); switchable Long Range (12 tiles, 1 s single shots) or Fast Attack (8 tiles, 4-ball bursts) mode, ground+air.

entities.title: Firespitter
entities.summary: Directional flamethrower turret (TH17): 16-tile range in a ~150-degree arc, bursts of 20 piercing fireballs (0.064 s apart) that each hit up to 2 units on ground and air.

entities.title: Revenge Tower
entities.summary: Dark Elixir TH18 defense that starts dormant and escalates through 3 stages as 5 / 25 / 50 of your buildings fall: 1.2 s single shots, then 0.6 s single-bounce, then 0.35 s double-bounce (11 tiles, ground+air).

entities.title: Super Wizard Tower/Home Village
entities.summary: Merged from two level 17 Wizard Towers (TH18): 8-tile, 1.3 s lightning bolt that chains to up to 15 more units within 4 tiles for 40% damage (ground+air).

entities.title: Wall/Home Village
entities.summary: 1x1 blocking segments (TH2+, up to 325 pieces, 19 levels up to 14,000 HP) paid in Gold, Elixir (level 5+) or Wall Rings; they stop most ground pathing but not jumpers or air.

entities.title: Clan Castle
entities.summary: Reinforcement bunker (troops/spells/siege) whose stored troops pour out to defend when an attacker enters its 13-tile trigger radius; also holds the Treasury.

entities.title: Town Hall
entities.summary: 4x4 core building (1 star when destroyed, stores loot); weaponized at TH12-17 (Giga Tesla, Giga Inferno, Inferno Artillery) and guarded by Guardians at TH18.

entities.title: Town Hall/Giga Weapons
entities.summary: Overview of the TH12-16 Town Hall weapons (Giga Tesla -> Giga Inferno): shared activation rule (damage or 51%), 4 targets, 10 tiles, death bomb that escalates from damage to slow to poison.

entities.title: Town Hall/Giga Tesla
entities.summary: TH12 weapon: dormant until the Town Hall is hit or 51% destruction, then zaps 4 targets (ground+air) for 140 DPS each (0.5 s, 10 tiles); 500 death damage in 4 tiles.

entities.title: Town Hall/Giga Inferno (TH13)
entities.summary: TH13 weapon: 4 inferno beams (ground+air, 10 tiles, 0.128 s ticks, 220 DPS each) after damage/51%; 700 death damage in 4 tiles plus a 50% slow for 8 s.

entities.title: Town Hall/Giga Inferno (TH14)
entities.summary: TH14 weapon: 4 inferno beams (280 DPS each) after damage/51%; death blast plus a 12 s poison (180 DPS max, 50% slow).

entities.title: Town Hall/Giga Inferno (TH15)
entities.summary: TH15 weapon: 4 inferno beams (300 DPS each) after damage/51%; 1,000 death damage in 4.5 tiles plus a 12 s poison.

entities.title: Town Hall/Giga Inferno (TH16)
entities.summary: TH16 weapon: 4 inferno beams (300 DPS each) after damage/51%; 1,100 death damage in 4.5 tiles plus a 12 s poison; merged with the Eagle Artillery for TH17.

entities.title: Town Hall/Inferno Artillery
entities.summary: TH17 Town Hall weapon (merge of TH16 + level 7 Eagle Artillery): always-active 12-tile launcher firing 4 homing fireballs every 3.5 s that leave 6.8 s fire pools (75 DPS max); 5 levels; no death bomb.

entities.title: Town Hall/Guardians
entities.summary: TH18 replaces the Town Hall weapon with one selectable Guardian (Longshot, Smasher or Logger) that waits on the Town Hall and jumps down to defend; Guardians are troops, not Heroes.

entities.title: Longshot
entities.summary: TH18 default Guardian: long-range (11 tiles) splash shooter hitting ground or air (1-tile splash on the hit layer), 1.8 s; explodes on death for 1,000 in 3.5 tiles.

entities.title: Smasher
entities.summary: TH18 melee tank Guardian: 1.25-tile club hitting ground+air with 2.5-tile splash (1.8 s); enrages (+60% damage, +12 speed) if the Town Hall falls and drops a defensive Rage Spell on death.

entities.title: Logger
entities.summary: TH18 Guardian (added Apr 27, 2026): slow log thrower (7 tiles, 2.5 s) whose rolling log pierces through ground and air units for 5-6 tiles past the target and pushes them back 1.5 tiles.

entities.title: Bomb
entities.summary: Basic hidden ground trap: ~1.5 s after a ground unit comes within 1.5 tiles it explodes for 20-200 splash damage in 3 tiles and knocks back small troops.

entities.title: Spring Trap/Home Village
entities.summary: Single-target ground trap (1-tile trigger) that flings the highest-housing unit off the map if it fits the 10-18 capacity; bigger units are launched, stunned and take 250-1,400 damage (halved vs heroes/pets/siege).

entities.title: Air Bomb
entities.summary: Air splash trap: triggered by a flyer within 4 tiles, rises and chases the nearest air unit, exploding for 100-425 in 3 tiles.

entities.title: Giant Bomb
entities.summary: 2x2 hidden ground bomb (2-tile trigger) dealing 175-490 splash in 3-4.2 tiles with knockback for small troops.

entities.title: Seeking Air Mine
entities.summary: Single-target air trap (4-tile trigger) that only reacts to air units of 5+ housing space and hits one of them for 1,500-3,350.

entities.title: Skeleton Trap
entities.summary: Hidden coffin (5-tile trigger) set to ground or air mode that spawns 2-5 Skeletons (level 5: level-2 Skeletons) to distract and attack that layer.

entities.title: Tornado Trap
entities.summary: One-per-base vortex trap (TH11): pulls ground and air units toward its center for 5-7 s, weaker on bigger units, while ticking ~8 DPS.

entities.title: Giga Bomb
entities.summary: Visible TH17 2x2 trap (former Town Hall death bomb): explodes when 18+ housing space of trap-triggering units is inside 3.5 tiles, dealing 1,100-1,400 to ground and air in 4.5 tiles with strong knockback.

entities.title: Crafting Station
entities.summary: Free 3x3 slot for seasonal Crafted Defenses: pick one of the phase's three defenses (swap freely), upgrade its 3 modules (10 levels each, defense level 3-30); defenses rotate every crafting phase.

entities.title: Hot Candle
entities.summary: Phase-4 Crafted Defense: multi-target flame thrower (10.5 tiles, 0.5 s, ground+air) with 6 flames that drop to 4 and then 3 as the candle melts over the battle.

entities.title: Hero Hunter
entities.summary: Phase-4 Crafted Defense ('Headhunter Tower' in files): 9.5-tile card cannon (0.6 s, ground+air) that prefers Heroes, deals them double damage and poisons every target for 3 s.

entities.title: Cake-A-Pult
entities.summary: Phase-4 Crafted Defense ('Cake Thrower' in files): 3-12 tile lobber (3 s) whose cake splashes 2.5 tiles on its target's layer and leaves a delayed bomb that hits ground and air.

entities.title: Supercharge
entities.summary: Post-max-level 'charges' (TH17-18): 2 charges for defenses (damage then HP; Air Defense damage twice) and 3 for collectors; removed when a new level arrives; each charge gives 10 Sparky Stones.

entities.title: Defensive Buildings/Home Village
entities.summary: Navigation list of every Home Village defensive building, Town Hall weapon and trap family covered by this dossier.

entities.title: Traps/Home Village
entities.summary: General trap rules: hidden until triggered, free automatic re-arm (always armed in war/Legend/friendly), no red zone, no builder needed to place or re-arm, not counted in destruction.

entities.title: Merged defenses (synthesized)
entities.summary: Synthesized merge rules (no wiki page): Ricochet Cannon, Multi-Archer Tower (non-geared inputs), Multi-Gear Tower (geared inputs), Inferno Artillery (TH16 + Eagle Artillery 7), Super Wizard Tower; permanent and required before the next Town Hall.

entities.title: Gear Up (synthesized)
entities.summary: Synthesized Gear Up rules (no wiki page): Master Builder converts one Cannon (burst), one Archer Tower (fast attack) and one Mortar (burst) permanently, gated by Builder Base defense levels.
